title: Modernize Data Access Layer
problem_statement: The application uses outdated ADO for data access, which is not suitable for a microservices architecture.
risk_if_unaddressed: Continued use of outdated data access methods may lead to security vulnerabilities and maintenance challenges.
suggested_approach: Refactor data access to use a modern ORM or direct database connections suitable for microservices.
success_criteria: Data access layer uses modern libraries.
No security vulnerabilities in data access.
